notes:
Background: early-stage YC-backed B2B SaaS (in-app chat assistants for SMB platforms). Signed up self-serve, exercised free credits. Interested primarily in hosted API (speed to production).

Key ask: low-latency streaming for UI-first chat. Target: first-byte latency <200ms for typical U.S. users, end-to-end response for short replies ~400ms. Heavy emphasis on streaming chunk frequency to avoid perceived lag in web client.

Traffic/scale: 2-3k MAU initially, peak concurrent active chats ~150-300, expected 25k-50k messages/month in first 6 months. Average prompt length ~120 tokens, responses ~150-300 tokens. Cost sensitivity high — wants guidance on per-message token optimization and suggestions for cheaper fallback models when load spikes.

Model preferences: prefer open-model compatibility (smaller Llama/Vicuna variants) but open to Redwood-curated lightweight variants. Wants default medium model for latency tests, with automatic fallback to smaller quantized for bursts.

Security/compliance: public-cloud acceptable. Must have SOC2 doc and SSO/SAML for admin console. Ask for audit logging retention details and shared responsibility notes for PII.

Recent activity timeline (bullets):
- 2026-02-25: Self-serve signup, used $200 trial credits, ran basic text-gen, saw streaming output but noted choppy first-chunk behavior.
- 2026-02-28: Intro call (Sofia) - product overview, explained hosted vs dedicated. Customer: 'we need the chat to feel instant — streaming is table stakes.'
- 2026-03-01: Deep-dive (Ethan) 45m; sent sample UI traces, discussed FBT and chunk size. Captured ff transcript ff-2026-03-01-7781.
- 2026-03-03: Internal security request from SimplyChat legal for SOC2 excerpt and SAML configuration guide (attached drive link). Jira INF-982 opened for streaming SDK question.
- 2026-03-05: Engineer-to-engineer sync scheduled to run live demo against us-west-2 hosted endpoint.

POC scope proposed: 2-week POC using hosted_api in us-west region, streaming enabled, target 200ms FBT for 90th percentile, instrument console traces, provide cost simulation for 50k messages/month. Short evaluation of prefix caching and token reduction (system prompt templating).

Sales notes / client language: short, choppy notes fine. They value code examples and quick integration guides. Quote from PM: 'If we can hit ~150–200ms first byte on web, we'll move fast.'

Next steps:
- Book 30m POC demo w/ engineering (Ethan + dev lead).
- Share SOC2 excerpt and minimal SAML setup doc before demo.
- Provide early cost estimate and suggested model profile + quantization options.

Potential upsell: transition to Dedicated once 100k+ messages/month and strict data isolation requested.

Internal ask: SE to prepare streaming sample app (React) and a short playbook for optimizing perceived latency (chunk size, flush frequency, KV cache tips).
